project.name: Merchant Stock Rescue
project.summary: A WebMCP-enabled local merchant inventory network where an agent finds nearby stock and prepares a transfer while the merchant retains approval authority.
project.ai_usage: OpenAI Codex was used for architecture, implementation, tests, browser QA, deployment, and submission drafting.
project.codex_usage: Codex coordinated focused workers, integrated the shared approval state, verified the WebMCP contracts, and prepared the delivery assets.
